# Gahez Live (جاهز Live)

> Gahez Live is a marketplace for live online classes in Egypt: students discover teachers, compare them, and book a class in seconds; teachers open their own live classes, set a schedule and a price, and get discovered. It is one of five independent products built by Gahez (جاهز); see https://gahez.space/llms.txt for the company-wide overview.

## What it does

- Students browse live and upcoming classes across subjects and grade levels, filter by subject, grade, price and rating, and book in seconds.
- Students compare teachers directly rather than being locked to one center or one teacher.
- Teachers open their own classes, set their own schedule and price, and are discoverable by students who haven't found them yet.
- Payment works on Android, iPhone and web.

## Who it's for

Students and parents in Egypt looking for a live-taught class outside a single fixed center, and teachers who want to teach online without building their own booking/payment system.
